Aphelios.watch: When Aphelios slows you with Gravitum, watch out for the root from Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites. If you’re slowed, immediately move out of range and spread out from allies so Aphelios R Moonlight Vigil’s damage doesn’t overlap. Back off while marked by Calibrum to avoid follow-up attacks.
Aphelios.build: Aphelios deals mostly physical damage, and Ezreal has low armor, so start with Cloth Armor to build armor first. Choose Plated Steelcaps for boots.
Aphelios.fight: Check the next weapon shown in Aphelios E Weapon Queue System, then trade during weapon windows with low burst damage. Apply Ezreal W Essence Flux, detonate it with Ezreal Q Mystic Shot, then follow with a basic attack. Usually save Ezreal E Arcane Shift for escape, and use it to close the gap only after the threat of the enemy’s root is gone.
Aphelios.laning: When you don’t know where the enemy jungler is, pull the wave by last hitting with basic attacks instead of pushing it with Ezreal Q Mystic Shot. If you lose health to a Calibrum mark, back off, and recall before you run low on mana.
Aphelios.combo: When Aphelios is away from the wave, poke in this order: Ezreal W Essence Flux → Ezreal Q Mystic Shot → basic attack. Detonating the orb with Ezreal Q Mystic Shot restores mana and brings your abilities’ cooldowns closer to completion. When you have an opening to chase, use W → basic attack → Q, then use Ezreal E Arcane Shift to reposition toward the enemy’s escape route and follow with basic attacks and, when needed, Ezreal R Trueshot Barrage.
Aphelios.escape: Engage after Aphelios’s Gravitum slow and the root threat from Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites are gone. When Aphelios isn’t holding Severum, his escape options are limited, so look for a chance to close the gap with Ezreal E Arcane Shift then. If the threat remains, save E and attack from max range with Ezreal Q Mystic Shot.
Aphelios.phase: Ezreal becomes stronger from mid game onward, once he completes two core items, so minimize losses instead of forcing fights before then. The information provided isn’t enough to judge which champion has the advantage late game.
Aphelios.teamfight: Spread out from allies to reduce the area damage from Aphelios R Moonlight Vigil. From max range behind your frontline, build damage with Ezreal Q Mystic Shot and Ezreal W Essence Flux. Save Ezreal E Arcane Shift to escape if an enemy gets on top of you.

Ashe.watch: Ashe W Volley slows in a cone, so move to the side of it to dodge. Ashe P Frost Shot reapplies its slow with every basic attack, so don’t stay within her attack range for long. Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow stuns, so don’t start a fight outside vision while her ultimate is available; if the arrow comes flying toward you, change direction to dodge.
Ashe.build: Buy Cloth Armor first to survive the early game. Ashe deals mostly physical damage, and Ezreal has relatively low armor, so build armor first and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots.
Ashe.fight: Take a short trade right after Ashe W Volley is used. Keep your distance while Ashe Q Ranger's Focus is active, and fight after it ends. Usually save Ezreal E Arcane Shift, and use it to engage only when Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow is down and it’s safe to close the gap.
Ashe.laning: If you don’t know where the enemy jungler is, reduce Q farming and pull the wave with basic attacks. If Ashe is away from the wave after you dodge Ashe W Volley to the side, poke with Ezreal W Essence Flux.
Ashe.combo: If Ashe is away from the wave and Ashe W Volley is down, poke in this order: Ezreal W Essence Flux → Ezreal Q Mystic Shot → basic attack. Detonate W with Q to restore mana, and hit Q to reduce your other abilities’ cooldowns. Use Ezreal E Arcane Shift to reposition and land a follow-up basic attack only when you can chase safely.
Ashe.escape: Ashe has no mobility ability, so the window to close the distance is when Ashe W Volley is down and Ashe Q Ranger's Focus has ended. If Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow is also down, you can approach with Ezreal E Arcane Shift. If her R is available or you don’t know where the enemy jungler is, save E for escape.
Ashe.phase: Ezreal comes online from mid game onward, once he completes two core items, so avoid forcing kills before then. The information provided isn’t enough to judge which of the two champions has the advantage late game; Ezreal should keep building damage from a safe distance.
Ashe.teamfight: From max range behind your frontline, build damage with Ezreal Q Mystic Shot and Ezreal W Essence Flux. Change direction as you move to account for Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow, and save Ezreal E Arcane Shift to escape if an enemy gets on top of you. You can finish Ashe as she flees toward an area where you have vision with Ezreal R Trueshot Barrage.

Caitlyn.watch: If you step on Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap, you’ll be rooted in place and hit by Caitlyn P Headshot’s increased range and empowered basic attack. Expect traps in brush and narrow paths, and change your route. Stand behind allied minions when Caitlyn uses Caitlyn Q Piltover Peacemaker to take reduced damage.
Caitlyn.build: Buy Cloth Armor first to withstand physical damage early. Choose Plated Steelcaps for boots to build armor. Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap’s root is also dangerous, so consider tenacity and movement speed later.
Caitlyn.fight: Trade right after Caitlyn uses Q Piltover Peacemaker on the wave. Save Ezreal E Arcane Shift for escape until then.
Caitlyn.laning: Survive Caitlyn’s strong early game by farming CS under your turret instead of looking for kills. When you don’t know where the enemy jungler is, reduce Q farming and pull the wave with basic attacks.
Caitlyn.combo: When Caitlyn is away from the minions, poke in this order: Ezreal W Essence Flux → Q Mystic Shot → basic attack. Detonating W with Q restores mana, and hitting Q also reduces your other abilities’ cooldowns.
Caitlyn.escape: Until then, save Ezreal E Arcane Shift. When going in, reposition to an angle where Q Mystic Shot will hit instead of moving straight toward her.
Caitlyn.phase: Caitlyn is strong early, so farm CS without giving up kills. Ezreal comes online from mid game onward, once he completes two core items, so minimize losses until then. Caitlyn’s relative strength declines as the game goes on, but Ezreal should still avoid stepping to the front late game.
Caitlyn.teamfight: From behind your frontline, build damage with Ezreal Q Mystic Shot and W Essence Flux. Save Ezreal E Arcane Shift to escape if an enemy gets on top of you. If enemies are grouped, sweep through multiple targets with Ezreal R Trueshot Barrage before the team fight.

Jinx.watch: Dodge the slow from Jinx W Zap! and the root from Jinx E Flame Chompers! Don’t stand near minions when Jinx hits them with Jinx Q Switcheroo! rockets, and watch out for a finishing blow from Jinx R Super Mega Death Rocket! when health has decreased.
Jinx.build: Survive the early game with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Jinx’s main damage is physical, and Ezreal has relatively low armor, so build armor first.
Jinx.fight: When Jinx pokes with rockets, look for an opening while her minigun attack speed stacks are down. Only close the gap with Ezreal E Arcane Shift after Jinx W Zap! misses and Jinx E Flame Chompers! is down; save it for escape until then.
Jinx.laning: Don’t stand on top of minions, so you don’t get hit along with them by Jinx’s rocket basic attacks. When you don’t know where the enemy jungler is, reduce farming with Ezreal Q Mystic Shot so you don’t push the wave.
Jinx.combo: When Jinx is away from the minions, apply Ezreal W Essence Flux, detonate it with Ezreal Q Mystic Shot, then follow with a basic attack. If Jinx E Flame Chompers! is down and you can keep fighting, use Ezreal E Arcane Shift to reposition and look for another hit with Ezreal Q Mystic Shot.
Jinx.escape: Jinx has no ability to create distance herself, so look to engage when Jinx W Zap! misses and Jinx E Flame Chompers!’ root is down. Use Ezreal E Arcane Shift to close the gap only during that opening; otherwise, save it to escape.
Jinx.phase: Ezreal comes online from mid game onward, once he completes two core items. The information provided isn’t enough to judge who has the advantage late game, so don’t start a fight right after Jinx P Get Excited! activates.
Jinx.teamfight: From behind your frontline, build damage with Ezreal Q Mystic Shot and Ezreal W Essence Flux. Save Ezreal E Arcane Shift to escape if an enemy gets on top of you, and avoid fights right after an ally dies or a turret falls and Jinx P Get Excited! activates.

Draven.watch: When Draven has two Draven Q Spinning Axes, avoid early trades. Watch out for the slow and displacement from Draven E Stand Aside, and keep your distance while Draven W Blood Rush increases his movement speed. After dodging Draven R Whirling Death once, stay clear of its return path too, and watch for its execute when your health is low.
Draven.build: Buy Cloth Armor first to survive the early game. Draven's main damage is physical, so build armor first and choose Plated Steelcaps for your boots. Keep your total health in mind because of the execute on Draven R Whirling Death.
Draven.fight: Don't trade hits with Draven while he has two axes. Fire Ezreal Q Mystic Shot where an axe will land: Draven either takes the hit to catch it or loses the axe by dodging. Look to trade when he has one or fewer axes and Draven E Stand Aside is on cooldown. Use Ezreal E Arcane Shift aggressively only after checking that you have a safe angle to escape.
Draven.laning: When you don't know where the enemy jungler is, last-hit with basic attacks so you don't push the wave by farming with Q. If the jungler is spotted on the opposite side, push with Q to recall or establish vision. If trades are unfavorable, focus on farming and don't give Draven a kill. Check your mana before recalling.
Draven.combo: When Draven is away from the minions and you can see where his axe will land, poke with Ezreal W Essence Flux → Ezreal Q Mystic Shot → basic attack. Detonate W with Q to get mana back, and landing Q also reduces the cooldowns of your other abilities. Before changing your angle with Ezreal E Arcane Shift, check that Draven E Stand Aside is on cooldown.
Draven.escape: Draven has no ability to create distance on his own, so an opening to engage appears when Draven E Stand Aside is on cooldown and he has one or fewer axes. Until then, save Ezreal E Arcane Shift to escape. Even when you engage, use E to cut off his escape route or adjust your Q angle rather than to close the gap.
Draven.phase: Draven is strong early while maintaining his axes, so Ezreal should prioritize CS and survival over kills. Ezreal is better at dealing sustained damage from mid game onward, once he completes two core items. In the late game, still respect the damage of a Draven who earned gold early, and target him with your team when he is alone.
Draven.teamfight: Build up damage from behind your frontline with Ezreal Q Mystic Shot and Ezreal W Essence Flux. Firing Q where an axe will land can disrupt Draven's ability to maintain his axes. Save Ezreal E Arcane Shift to escape if an enemy closes in, and get completely clear of the outbound and return paths of Draven R Whirling Death.

Kaisa.watch: If Kai'Sa W Void Seeker hits you, you can become a target for Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct, so retreat toward your allies until the mark disappears. Stand beside allied minions when Kai'Sa uses Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain to spread out the damage, and wait out the stacks of Kai'Sa P Second Skin from outside her range.
Kaisa.build: Buy Cloth Armor first in the early game and choose Plated Steelcaps for your boots. Kai'Sa's main damage is physical, and Ezreal has relatively low armor, so build armor first.
Kaisa.fight: While Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct is available, don't use Ezreal E Arcane Shift to move forward; save it to respond to her engage. Once Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct is on cooldown, apply Ezreal W Essence Flux, detonate it with Ezreal Q Mystic Shot, then follow with a basic attack.
Kaisa.laning: When you don't know where the enemy jungler is, don't push the wave with Ezreal Q Mystic Shot; use basic attacks to hold the wave near you. If the enemy jungler is spotted on the opposite side, push with Ezreal Q Mystic Shot to recall or establish vision.
Kaisa.combo: When Kai'Sa is away from the wave, poke with Ezreal W Essence Flux → Ezreal Q Mystic Shot → basic attack. Detonating Ezreal W Essence Flux with Ezreal Q Mystic Shot restores mana, and landing Q also reduces the cooldowns of your other abilities.
Kaisa.escape: Consider using Ezreal E Arcane Shift to close the gap only while Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct is on cooldown. If Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct is available, save Ezreal E Arcane Shift for escape and adjusting your angle.
Kaisa.phase: Ezreal hits his stride from mid game onward, once he completes two core items, so farm CS and minimize losses until then. The provided information isn't enough to determine which champion has the advantage in the late game.
Kaisa.teamfight: Build up damage from the very back with Ezreal Q Mystic Shot and Ezreal W Essence Flux, and save Ezreal E Arcane Shift to respond to an engage from Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct. Since Kai'Sa can disappear from view on a flank with Kai'Sa E Supercharge, place Control Wards in the side bushes and approach routes before a fight.

Jhin.watch: When Jhin P Whisper has its fourth shot ready, back off to avoid taking heavy damage. After being hit by Jhin's basic attack or trap, watch for the root from Jhin W Deadly Flourish and move out of a straight line. When your health is low, dodge Jhin R Curtain Call, which deals more damage based on your missing health.
Jhin.build: Buy Cloth Armor first in the early game and choose Plated Steelcaps for your boots. Jhin's main damage is physical, and Ezreal has relatively low armor, so build armor first.
Jhin.fight: Try to trade while Jhin is reloading or after he has fired one or two shots, and back off if his fourth shot is ready. Apply Ezreal W Essence Flux, then detonate it with Ezreal Q Mystic Shot to deal damage and get mana back. Use Ezreal E Arcane Shift aggressively only when dangerous tools like Jhin W Deadly Flourish are on cooldown and you can safely close the gap.
Jhin.laning: Stand away from low-health minions to avoid the empowered bounce damage from Jhin Q Dancing Grenade when it kills a target. If you don't know where the enemy jungler is, don't keep pushing the wave with Ezreal Q Mystic Shot; use basic attacks to hold the wave near you.
Jhin.combo: When Jhin is away from the wave, poke with Ezreal W Essence Flux → Ezreal Q Mystic Shot → basic attack. If Jhin W Deadly Flourish is on cooldown and an all-in is safe, use Ezreal W Essence Flux → basic attack → Ezreal Q Mystic Shot, then use Ezreal E Arcane Shift to change your angle toward the enemy's escape route.
Jhin.escape: Use Ezreal E Arcane Shift to close the gap only when Jhin W Deadly Flourish is on cooldown. Jhin has no ability to create distance on his own, but Ezreal E Arcane Shift is your only escape, so save it to get away if other threats remain.
Jhin.teamfight: Build up damage from the very back with Ezreal Q Mystic Shot and Ezreal W Essence Flux, and save Ezreal E Arcane Shift to escape from anyone who engages on you. Keep a safe range while your frontline goes in first and absorbs Jhin W Deadly Flourish and the shots from Jhin R Curtain Call. If health has decreased, focus on dodging Jhin R Curtain Call, whose damage increases in proportion to missing health.
Jhin.phase: Ezreal gets stronger in the mid game after completing two core items, so minimize losses until then. The available information isn’t enough to determine which champion has the advantage in the late game.

Kalista.watch: Kalista Q Pierce and Kalista E Rend are the core of her physical damage, so if several spears are stuck in you, stop fighting and retreat until they disappear. To prepare for Kalista R Fate's Call, spread out and save Ezreal E Arcane Shift when her bound support stays close to her. The percent-max-health damage from Kalista W Sentinel isn't mitigated by armor.
Kalista.build: Buy Cloth Armor first in the early game to withstand Kalista's main physical damage. Choose Plated Steelcaps for your boots and prioritize armor.
Kalista.fight: When Kalista starts the windup for a basic attack, predict her hop direction and hit her with Ezreal Q Mystic Shot. Build up damage from outside Kalista's range, and use Ezreal E Arcane Shift aggressively only after Kalista R Fate's Call is on cooldown.
Kalista.laning: If you don't know where the enemy jungler is, hold the wave near you with basic attacks instead of pushing it by farming with Q. If several spears are stuck in you, retreat from the lane before Kalista E Rend hits.
Kalista.combo: When Kalista is away from the minions, poke with Ezreal W Essence Flux → Ezreal Q Mystic Shot → basic attack. Detonating W with Q restores mana, and landing Q also reduces the cooldowns of your other abilities. Once Kalista R Fate's Call is on cooldown and you have a safe angle, use Ezreal E Arcane Shift to reposition to the side and set up your next Q.
Kalista.escape: The window while Kalista R Fate's Call is on cooldown is an opportunity to close the gap with Ezreal E Arcane Shift. However, Kalista P Martial Poise still lets her hop, so don't fight for long within her basic attack range. If R is available or her spear stacks have built up, save E to escape.
Kalista.phase: Once you complete two core items in mid game, use Ezreal Q Mystic Shot to build up sustained damage. The provided information isn't enough to determine which champion is stronger in the late game, so keep building up damage from maximum range then too.
Kalista.teamfight: Build up damage from behind your frontline with Ezreal Q Mystic Shot and Ezreal W Essence Flux. If Kalista's support stays close to her, spread out to watch for Kalista R Fate's Call. Save Ezreal E Arcane Shift so you can escape after an enemy engages.

KogMaw.watch: When Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage is active, his attack range and percent-of-max-health damage increase, so keep your distance until it wears off. Block Kog'Maw Q Caustic Spittle with minions or sidestep it; if it hits you, avoid fighting while your armor and magic resistance are reduced. Watch out for the slow from Kog'Maw E Void Ooze, and when low on health, dodge Kog'Maw R Living Artillery and recover out of sight. After taking down Kog'Maw, move away from his corpse to avoid the explosion from Kog'Maw P Icathian Surprise.
KogMaw.build: Build magic resistance first to mitigate the magic damage from Kog'Maw Q Caustic Spittle, Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage, and Kog'Maw E Void Ooze. His basic attacks also deal significant damage, so consider armor too, but avoid relying only on health because of Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage. Reducing his attack speed also helps limit his basic attack damage.
KogMaw.fight: Look to fight after Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage wears off. Dodge Kog'Maw Q Caustic Spittle, and when Kog'Maw E Void Ooze is on cooldown, apply Ezreal W Essence Flux and detonate it with Ezreal Q Mystic Shot to build damage. Save Ezreal E Arcane Shift primarily for escaping and adjusting your angle.
KogMaw.laning: When you don't know where the enemy jungler is, don't keep pushing the wave with Ezreal Q Mystic Shot; use basic attacks to hold the wave closer to your side. When Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage is active, keep your distance. Look for a chance to disrupt Kog'Maw's farming after it wears off.
KogMaw.combo: If Kog'Maw is away from the minions and Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage has worn off, poke with Ezreal W Essence Flux → Ezreal Q Mystic Shot → basic attack. Detonating Ezreal W Essence Flux with Ezreal Q Mystic Shot stacks the damage and refunds mana. For a longer trade, use Ezreal W Essence Flux → basic attack → Ezreal Q Mystic Shot, and only use Ezreal E Arcane Shift to change your angle when it's safe.
KogMaw.escape: Kog'Maw has no mobility spell, so you don't need to wait for one to be used. When Kog'Maw E Void Ooze is on cooldown and Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage has worn off, that's your chance to close the distance. Even if you use Ezreal E Arcane Shift to go in, it's your only escape, so first check whether you can dodge the next threat.
KogMaw.phase: After your second core item is completed, from mid game onward, build damage with Ezreal Q Mystic Shot and Ezreal W Essence Flux. Kog'Maw gets stronger as the game goes on, so take opportunities to secure turrets and objectives in the early and mid game.
KogMaw.teamfight: Stay back and build up damage with Ezreal Q Mystic Shot and Ezreal W Essence Flux. Save Ezreal E Arcane Shift to escape if the enemy gets on top of you. Don’t fight Kog'Maw at long range while Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage is active. If an ally engages on and catches Kog'Maw, attack him while he has no mobility, then back away after the kill to avoid Kog'Maw P Icathian Surprise.

Lucian.watch: Lucian Q Piercing Light passes through minions and extends beyond its indicated range, so don't stand directly behind a minion when Lucian uses Q to farm. Lucian R The Culling can't change its aim during the cast, so sidestep instead of running straight backward. If the enemy support shields or heals Lucian, or an ally is immobilized, Lucian's next two shots are empowered, so avoid trading.
Lucian.build: Buy Cloth Armor early to withstand Lucian's physical damage. Build armor first for resistances, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots.
Lucian.fight: Let Lucian's first combo pass, then retaliate when his abilities are on cooldown. There's a brief opening right after Lucian E Relentless Pursuit, but don't extend the trade: prolonged basic attack trades quickly reduce Lucian E's cooldown. Save Ezreal E Arcane Shift to respond to Lucian's engage, and use it aggressively only after Lucian E is on cooldown.
Lucian.laning: If you don't know where the enemy jungler is, reduce Q farming and use basic attacks to hold the wave closer to your side. If you spot the enemy jungler on the other side of the map, push with Q and then recall or establish vision.
Lucian.combo: When Lucian E Relentless Pursuit is on cooldown and Lucian is away from the minions, poke with Ezreal W Essence Flux → Ezreal Q Mystic Shot → basic attack. Detonating W with Q refunds mana, and hitting Q reduces Ezreal's ability cooldowns.
Lucian.phase: In this phase, reduce losses by focusing on CS and building damage rather than kills. Ezreal comes online from mid game onward, once he has completed two core items.
Lucian.teamfight: Build damage from the edge of your range behind your team's frontline with Ezreal Q Mystic Shot and Ezreal W Essence Flux. Save Ezreal E Arcane Shift so you can escape if an opponent like Lucian closes in.
Lucian.escape: The moment after Lucian uses Lucian E Relentless Pursuit is your window to close the gap. If you use Ezreal E Arcane Shift aggressively then, change your angle to the side to land Ezreal Q Mystic Shot rather than going deep forward. Save Ezreal E for escape if Lucian E is available or he can fire two empowered shots.

MissFortune.watch: Miss Fortune Q Double Up bounces through minions, so don't stand directly behind a minion. If Miss Fortune R Bullet Time overlaps with the slow from Miss Fortune E Make It Rain, you're in danger, so leave the zone. When her ultimate starts, use Ezreal E Arcane Shift to sidestep the fixed cone.
MissFortune.build: Buy Cloth Armor first early on, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Miss Fortune P Love Tap, Miss Fortune Q Double Up, and Miss Fortune R Bullet Time deal primarily physical damage, so build armor first. Armor does not mitigate the magic damage from Miss Fortune E Make It Rain.
MissFortune.fight: When Miss Fortune is away from the minions, apply Ezreal W Essence Flux and detonate it with Ezreal Q Mystic Shot for a short trade. Miss Fortune has no mobility spell, but the default is to save Ezreal E Arcane Shift for escape. Use Ezreal E Arcane Shift to change your angle sideways or close the distance only during an opening after Miss Fortune E Make It Rain has been used and the enemy jungler's location is known.
MissFortune.laning: Back away immediately after Miss Fortune attacks a minion, and don't stand in a line with the minions so you can avoid the bounce from Miss Fortune Q Double Up. If you don't know where the enemy jungler is, don't push the lane with Ezreal Q Mystic Shot; use basic attacks to pull it toward your side, and time your recall around your mana.
MissFortune.escape: Miss Fortune has no mobility spell, so you don't need to wait for one to be used. After Miss Fortune E Make It Rain, leave the zone, and look to engage when the angle of Miss Fortune R Bullet Time's cone is safe. After using Ezreal E Arcane Shift forward, you have no escape, so don't engage if you don't know where the enemy jungler is.
MissFortune.phase: Ezreal is weak early, so dodge Miss Fortune's poke and focus on CS and building damage. Ezreal gets stronger from mid game onward, once he has completed two core items, so limit losses until then. The information provided isn't enough to judge which champion is stronger late game, so keep your distance in teamfights and build damage.
MissFortune.teamfight: Build damage from behind your team's frontline with Ezreal Q Mystic Shot and Ezreal W Essence Flux, and save Ezreal E Arcane Shift until you need to escape. Don't start a fight where Miss Fortune E Make It Rain is active; move outside it. When Miss Fortune R Bullet Time starts, sidestep the cone. If the enemy team is grouped before a teamfight, sweep through them with Ezreal R Trueshot Barrage.
MissFortune.combo: When Miss Fortune moves away from the wave, poke with Ezreal W Essence Flux → Ezreal Q Mystic Shot → a basic attack. Detonating Ezreal W Essence Flux with Ezreal Q Mystic Shot restores mana, and landing Q brings his other abilities back sooner. When you can safely close the gap, use Ezreal W Essence Flux → a basic attack → Ezreal Q Mystic Shot, then use Ezreal E Arcane Shift to adjust your angle along her escape route and follow up with a basic attack.

Samira.watch: Projectiles are destroyed while Samira W Blade Whirl spins, so cast Ezreal Q Mystic Shot after the spin ends. If you get hit by the enemy support's crowd control, Samira can dash to you with Samira P Daredevil Impulse, so dodge their engage ability first. If Samira gets close and lands several different types of attacks, she can follow up with Samira R Inferno Trigger, so quickly create distance.
Samira.build: Buy Cloth Armor early to survive. Samira deals primarily physical damage, so build armor first and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots.
Samira.fight: Maintain your distance and poke with Ezreal Q Mystic Shot when Samira walks up to make up for her short range. Fire your projectiles after Samira W Blade Whirl ends. If Samira E Wild Rush is on cooldown and no one died, that's an opportunity to trade. Generally save Ezreal E Arcane Shift for escape, and use it aggressively only after Samira's engage ability is on cooldown.
Samira.laning: When you don't know where the enemy jungler is, use basic attacks to hold the wave closer to your side rather than pushing it with Ezreal Q Mystic Shot. If Samira is behind minions, save Ezreal W Essence Flux and poke when she moves away from the wave.
Samira.combo: If Samira W Blade Whirl has ended and Samira is away from the wave, poke with Ezreal W Essence Flux → Ezreal Q Mystic Shot → basic attack. Detonating W with Q refunds mana, and hitting Q reduces your other ability cooldowns. Even when fighting longer after Samira E Wild Rush is on cooldown, use Ezreal E Arcane Shift to angle toward the direction of escape, and finish if needed with Ezreal R Trueshot Barrage.
Samira.escape: Don't use Ezreal E Arcane Shift to go in while Samira E Wild Rush or the enemy support's crowd control is still available. If Samira E is on cooldown and no one died to reset it, you can use Ezreal E to adjust your distance while attacking.
Samira.phase: Ezreal is weak early, so your priority is to withstand Samira's engage. Ezreal gets stronger from mid game onward, once he has completed two core items, so focus on CS and building damage until then. The information provided isn't enough to determine who is stronger late game.
Samira.teamfight: Dodge the enemy's engage abilities and build damage from the backline with Ezreal Q Mystic Shot and Ezreal W Essence Flux. Save your projectiles while Samira W Blade Whirl is active, and use Ezreal E Arcane Shift to escape when Samira engages. Samira E Wild Rush may reset if an ally dies, so don't leave low-health allies behind when retreating.

Senna.watch: Senna Q Piercing Darkness passes through allies or minions, slowing enemies and healing allies, so step out of the line between Senna and her target. Senna W Last Embrace roots, so dodge it from behind minions. If it hits you, move away from allies while the mark is visible. After Senna hits you once, back off to avoid a second attack and deny her Mist collection.
Senna.build: Buy Cloth Armor first, then get Plated Steelcaps early. Senna’s main damage is physical, so prioritize armor. If Senna Q Piercing Darkness’s healing is a problem, buy Executioner’s Calling early and apply Grievous Wounds with Ezreal Q Mystic Shot.
Senna.fight: When Senna steps forward to collect a soul, tag her with Ezreal W Essence Flux and detonate it with Ezreal Q Mystic Shot to poke. If Senna hits you once, create distance to avoid a second attack. Keep Ezreal E Arcane Shift for escapes, and only consider an aggressive entry after Senna W Last Embrace is down.
Senna.laning: If you don’t know where the enemy jungler is, pull the wave with basic attacks instead of constantly pushing with Ezreal Q Mystic Shot. Step out of the line of Senna Q Piercing Darkness and stand behind minions to block Senna W Last Embrace.
Senna.combo: When Senna is away from the minions, poke with Ezreal W Essence Flux → Ezreal Q Mystic Shot → basic attack. Detonating Ezreal W Essence Flux with Ezreal Q Mystic Shot refunds mana. When Senna W Last Embrace is down and you can all-in, attack with Ezreal W Essence Flux → basic attack → Ezreal Q Mystic Shot, and only use Ezreal E Arcane Shift to change your angle if it’s safe.
Senna.escape: The window to close the distance is after Senna W Last Embrace is down and Senna E Curse of the Black Mist ends. Ezreal E Arcane Shift is your only escape, though, so make sure you can get out safely before using it forward.
Senna.phase: Ezreal comes online in the mid game, starting when he completes two core items. If left alone, Senna’s range and attack damage keep growing into the late game, so poke her from the start whenever she steps up to collect souls.
Senna.teamfight: Build damage from maximum range behind your frontline with Ezreal Q Mystic Shot and Ezreal W Essence Flux, and save Ezreal E Arcane Shift to escape if an enemy closes in. If you see Senna E Curse of the Black Mist, back away and move to a spot with vision. If the enemy team is grouped and you can see them, sweep through them with Ezreal R Trueshot Barrage before the team fight.

Seraphine.laning: If you don’t know where the enemy jungler is, don’t keep pushing the wave by last-hitting with Ezreal Q Mystic Shot; pull it with basic attacks instead. When poking, detonate Ezreal W Essence Flux with an ability to manage your mana.
Seraphine.phase: Ezreal’s power spike comes in the mid game, after he completes two core items. The available information isn’t enough to judge which side has the advantage late game.
Seraphine.build: Buy Executioner's Calling early to counter healing from Seraphine W Surround Sound. You can apply Grievous Wounds from range with Ezreal Q Mystic Shot, then maintain it in team fights by upgrading to Mortal Reminder. Build magic resistance rather than armor to defend against Seraphine's damage.
Seraphine.combo: When Seraphine moves away from the minion wave, poke with Ezreal W Essence Flux → Ezreal Q Mystic Shot → a basic attack. If Seraphine E Beat Drop is down and you can safely move in, use Ezreal W Essence Flux → a basic attack → Ezreal Q Mystic Shot, then use Ezreal E Arcane Shift to adjust your angle if needed.
Seraphine.escape: Seraphine has no mobility, so right after dodging Seraphine E Beat Drop is your chance to close the gap with Ezreal E Arcane Shift. However, Ezreal E is your only escape, so save it to get away if the enemy has another engage threat available.
Seraphine.fight: Right after dodging Seraphine E Beat Drop, trade if Seraphine is separated from her allied marksman. Start with Ezreal W Essence Flux, detonate it with Ezreal Q Mystic Shot, then follow with a basic attack. Before using Ezreal E Arcane Shift to move forward, make sure the enemy's crowd control is down and you’ll be safe from the next threat.
Seraphine.teamfight: Spread out from your allies to either side so Seraphine R Encore cannot chain through multiple targets. Build up damage from the edge of your range behind your frontline with Ezreal Q Mystic Shot and Ezreal W Essence Flux. Save Ezreal E Arcane Shift to escape if an enemy gets on top of you.
Seraphine.watch: Seraphine E Beat Drop roots slowed targets and stuns immobilized targets.

Tristana.watch: Tristana W Rocket Jump is a dash that slows, and she can cast it again if she gets a takedown, so create distance with Ezreal E Arcane Shift when you see her jump. Tristana R Buster Shot stuns and knocks you away, so don’t engage while both W and R are available. Also watch out for the area damage from Tristana E Explosive Charge when you’re near allied minions.
Tristana.fight: Save Ezreal E Arcane Shift while Tristana W Rocket Jump is available, and safely build damage with Ezreal Q Mystic Shot. Right after Tristana uses W is a window to close the distance, but don’t rush in if Tristana R Buster Shot is still available.
Tristana.combo: When Tristana is away from the minion wave, poke with Ezreal W Essence Flux → Ezreal Q Mystic Shot → basic attack. Detonating W with Q refunds mana, and hitting with Q also reduces the cooldowns of your other abilities.
Tristana.escape: Right after Tristana uses W Rocket Jump is a window to close the distance with Ezreal E Arcane Shift. If Tristana R Buster Shot is available, delay your engage, and watch for situations where Tristana can reset W by getting a takedown.
Tristana.phase: Ezreal comes online in the mid game, after he completes two core items, so minimize losses until then. Tristana is hard to handle at full build, so aim to end the game before that point.
Tristana.teamfight: Build damage from maximum range behind your frontline with Ezreal Q Mystic Shot and Ezreal W Essence Flux, and save Ezreal E Arcane Shift to respond to Tristana’s engage. If an ally goes down, Tristana W Rocket Jump may reset, so retreat immediately and don’t leave a squishy ally in front.
Tristana.laning: Stand away from allied minions when Tristana is last-hitting so you don’t take the splash damage from Tristana E Explosive Charge. If the enemy jungler is spotted on the opposite side, push the lane to make it harder for Tristana to last-hit under her tower. If their position is unknown, limit Q farming so the lane doesn’t push too far.

Smolder.watch: Smolder W Achooo! slows champions it hits and grants stacking growth, so dodge it by standing behind minions or moving sideways. Smolder R MMOOOMMMM! deals heavy damage at the center and heals Smolder, so move out of the flames before attacking again. Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath gains true damage and an execute as it stacks, so don’t approach with reduced health.
Smolder.build: Survive the early game with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for your boots. Smolder deals mostly physical damage and Ezreal has relatively low armor, so build armor first. If the healing from Smolder R MMOOOMMMM! is a problem, buy Executioner’s Calling early and apply Grievous Wounds with Ezreal Q Mystic Shot.
Smolder.fight: While Smolder is weak early, keep pressuring him with Ezreal Q Mystic Shot to slow the growth of Smolder P Dragon Practice. Use Ezreal W Essence Flux when Smolder is away from minions, then detonate it with Ezreal Q Mystic Shot to get mana back. Use Ezreal E Arcane Shift to adjust your angle aggressively only after Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap is down.
Smolder.laning: Dodge Smolder W Achooo! while disrupting his farming to slow the stacks on Smolder P Dragon Practice. If you don’t know where the enemy jungler is, don’t keep pushing the wave with Ezreal Q Mystic Shot; pull it with basic attacks instead.
Smolder.combo: When Smolder is away from the minions, poke with Ezreal W Essence Flux → Ezreal Q Mystic Shot → basic attack. If Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap is down and you have an opening to catch him, attack with Ezreal W Essence Flux → basic attack → Ezreal Q Mystic Shot. When needed, use Ezreal E Arcane Shift to adjust your angle to match the direction of escape, then follow with a basic attack and Ezreal R Trueshot Barrage.
Smolder.escape: Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap is his only escape, so the window to go in is immediately after you force him to use it. Dodge the slow from Smolder W Achooo! and make sure Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap is down before closing the distance with Ezreal E Arcane Shift. Don’t follow him into the flames from Smolder R MMOOOMMMM!.
Smolder.phase: Ezreal comes online in the mid game, after he completes two core items, so farm CS, build up damage, and minimize losses until then. Smolder P Dragon Practice puts you at an increasing disadvantage as the game goes on, so take turrets and objectives quickly in the mid game.
Smolder.teamfight: Build damage with Ezreal Q Mystic Shot and Ezreal W Essence Flux from behind your frontline. Avoid the center and flames of Smolder R MMOOOMMMM!, and save Ezreal E Arcane Shift to escape if an enemy closes in. Use Ezreal R Trueshot Barrage on grouped enemies before the team fight starts.

TwistedFate.watch: If Twisted Fate is holding the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card, stay out of his basic attack range.
TwistedFate.build: Get movement speed first so you can leave the warned attack area. All of Twisted Fate’s damaging abilities deal magic damage, so build magic resistance if you need resistances.
TwistedFate.fight: When the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card is gone, tag him with Ezreal W Essence Flux and detonate it with Ezreal Q Mystic Shot to trade. Keep Ezreal E Arcane Shift for escaping by default, and use it to close the gap only after Twisted Fate R Destiny is also down.
TwistedFate.laning: However, last-hitting repeatedly with Ezreal Q Mystic Shot will push the lane, so use basic attacks to pull the wave toward you when you don’t know where the enemy jungler is.
TwistedFate.escape: Don’t go in first with Ezreal E Arcane Shift while Twisted Fate still has the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card. The window to close the gap is after he uses the gold card and Twisted Fate R Destiny is down; otherwise, keep Ezreal E Arcane Shift for escaping.
TwistedFate.phase: Ezreal comes online after completing two core items in the mid game, so minimize losses until then. In the late game, deal damage from behind your frontline.
TwistedFate.teamfight: Deal damage from the edge of your range behind your frontline with Ezreal Q Mystic Shot and Ezreal W Essence Flux. Stay out of range of the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card, and save Ezreal E Arcane Shift to escape if an enemy closes in.
TwistedFate.combo: When Twisted Fate is away from the minions and has used his yellow card, attack with Ezreal W Essence Flux → Ezreal Q Mystic Shot → basic attack. Detonating the orb with Ezreal Q restores mana, and landing Ezreal Q also reduces the cooldowns of your other abilities.

Sivir.watch: Sivir Q Boomerang Blade can hit both on the way out and on the way back, so dodge the first hit and move out of its return path too. Sivir E Spell Shield blocks one ability, so don’t use Ezreal W Essence Flux or Ezreal Q Mystic Shot carelessly while the shield is up. When Sivir R On The Hunt is active, the entire enemy team moves faster, so avoid long chases.
Sivir.build: Sivir’s main damage is physical, and Ezreal has low armor, so build armor first. Use Cloth Armor to hold on in the early game, and choose Plated Steelcaps for your boots.
Sivir.fight: Draw out Sivir E Spell Shield first. When Sivir is away from the wave, trade with Ezreal W Essence Flux → Q Mystic Shot → basic attack. Keep Ezreal E Arcane Shift for escaping by default, and use it offensively only when you can close the gap safely.
Sivir.laning: When you don’t know where the enemy jungler is, don’t keep pushing the wave with Q; use basic attacks to keep the wave pulled toward you. Sivir clears waves quickly, so if you need to leave lane, push beforehand or make sure an ally is ready to catch the wave.
Sivir.combo: If Sivir E Spell Shield is down and Sivir is away from the minions, apply Ezreal W Essence Flux, detonate it with Q Mystic Shot, then follow with a basic attack. When you have an angle for a longer fight, deal damage in this order: W Essence Flux → basic attack → Q Mystic Shot. Use E Arcane Shift to adjust your angle only when needed, then follow with a basic attack and R Trueshot Barrage.
Sivir.escape: The chance to close the gap comes after Sivir E Spell Shield is down and R On The Hunt has ended. Sivir has no blink or teleport ability, but Ezreal E Arcane Shift is your only escape, so use it aggressively only after the enemy’s engage tools are down.
Sivir.phase: Ezreal is weak early, and Sivir clears waves quickly, so focus on CS and maintaining a safe lane rather than getting kills. Ezreal comes online after completing two core items in the mid game, so minimize losses until then. The available information isn’t enough to judge which champion is stronger late game; in teamfights, deal damage from behind.
Sivir.teamfight: Deal damage from behind your frontline with Ezreal Q Mystic Shot and W Essence Flux, and save E Arcane Shift to escape if an enemy closes in. When Sivir E Spell Shield is down, your allies have a chance to catch her. While Sivir R On The Hunt is active, avoid long chases and take only short fights near terrain and vision.

Twitch.watch: Leave immediately if Twitch W Venom Cask lands at your feet. Once Twitch P Deadly Venom has stacked, Twitch E Contaminate can finish you even if you still have health, so use Ezreal E Arcane Shift to create distance before taking several basic attacks. When Twitch R Spray and Pray is active, his range increases and his basic attacks pierce, so don’t line up with your allies.
Twitch.build: In lane, get a Control Ward early to prepare for Twitch Q Ambush. Twitch E Contaminate deals mixed damage, so building only one type of resistance blocks just part of it, and resistance cannot reduce the true damage from Twitch P Deadly Venom. After that, consider health and ways to reduce the opponent’s attack speed, but the available information doesn’t establish a specific item purchase order.
Twitch.fight: When Twitch Q Ambush ends and his position is revealed, harass from a safe distance by applying Ezreal W Essence Flux and detonating it with Ezreal Q Mystic Shot. Hitting with Ezreal Q Mystic Shot also brings Ezreal E Arcane Shift back sooner, but don’t let a fight with repeated Twitch basic attacks drag on. Use Ezreal E Arcane Shift to adjust your angle only after dodging Twitch W Venom Cask and when there’s no threat of being chased.
Twitch.laning: If Twitch disappears from lane, alert your allies. Check bushes you have no vision of with a Control Ward before passing through them. When you don’t know where the enemy jungler is, don’t keep pushing the wave with Q; use basic attacks to keep it pulled toward you.
Twitch.combo: If Twitch is away from the wave and his position is revealed, harass in this order: Ezreal W Essence Flux → Ezreal Q Mystic Shot → basic attack. Detonating W with Q restores mana, and hitting with Q also reduces the cooldowns of other abilities. If you have an angle to keep fighting, add more basic attacks and Qs, but use Ezreal E Arcane Shift to adjust your angle only when there’s no threat of being chased.
Twitch.escape: After leaving the slow zone from Twitch W Venom Cask, you can use Ezreal E Arcane Shift to close the gap if Twitch Q Ambush has ended, his position is revealed, and there’s no threat of being chased. Otherwise, save E to create distance if Twitch approaches or lands repeated basic attacks.
Twitch.phase: Ezreal comes online after completing two core items in the mid game, so minimize losses until then. The available information doesn’t establish which champion is stronger late game; position with the increased range of Twitch R Spray and Pray in mind.
Twitch.teamfight: From behind your frontline, deal damage with Ezreal Q Mystic Shot and Ezreal W Essence Flux, and save Ezreal E Arcane Shift for when an enemy engages on you. When Twitch R Spray and Pray is active, spread out to the side of his attack direction so you aren’t all hit by his piercing basic attacks. When Twitch Q Ambush ends and reveals his position, coordinate with your allies to focus the same target.

Xayah.watch: Xayah E Bladecaller roots you if three or more returning feathers hit, so don’t fight for long where feathers have piled up. Sidestep out of the line between Xayah and her feathers, and use Ezreal E Arcane Shift to escape if it’s hard to get out of their return path.
Xayah.build: Xayah’s main damage is physical, and Ezreal has low armor, so build armor first. Use Cloth Armor to hold on in the early game, and choose Plated Steelcaps for your boots.
Xayah.fight: Keep trades with Xayah short and change position each time so feathers don’t pile up at your feet. Save Ezreal E Arcane Shift for escaping, and use it to engage only after Xayah R Featherstorm is down and you’ve avoided the feather recall path.
Xayah.laning: When you don’t know where the enemy jungler is, reduce Q farming and use basic attacks to pull the wave toward you. If the enemy jungler is spotted on the opposite side, push with Q and recall or establish vision.
Xayah.combo: When Xayah is away from the minions, briefly harass in this order: Ezreal W Essence Flux → Q Mystic Shot → basic attack. Detonate W with Q to restore mana, and reposition before Xayah’s feathers pile up. After Xayah R Featherstorm is down, if you have a clear angle, fight in this order: W → basic attack → Q → E Arcane Shift to adjust your angle → basic attack. Use R Trueshot Barrage if needed.
Xayah.escape: First dodge the return path of three or more feathers, then use Ezreal E Arcane Shift to close the gap.
Xayah.phase: Ezreal comes online after completing two core items in the mid game, so minimize losses until then. The available information isn’t enough to determine which side is stronger late game.
Xayah.teamfight: Deal damage from the farthest back with Ezreal Q Mystic Shot and W Essence Flux, and save E Arcane Shift to escape if an enemy closes in. Don’t go in first while Xayah R Featherstorm is available. Confirm that R is down and avoid the feather recall path before deciding whether to engage.

Vayne.watch: If Vayne E Condemn knocks you into a wall, you’ll be stunned, so stand in the open without a wall behind you. Vayne W Silver Bolts deals true damage based on your max health after repeated attacks on the same target, so move out of range before it triggers.
Vayne.build: Start with Cloth Armor to survive lane, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Build armor first to deal with Vayne’s main physical damage, but armor can’t block the true damage from Vayne W Silver Bolts.
Vayne.fight: Bait out Vayne Q Tumble, then trade once you’ve confirmed Vayne E Condemn is also down. Mark her with Ezreal W Essence Flux and detonate it with Ezreal Q Mystic Shot to deal damage and restore mana. Don’t use Ezreal E Arcane Shift forward first; save it to change your angle when a safe opening appears.
Vayne.laning: Pressure Vayne’s weak early game, but if you don’t know where the enemy jungler is, pull the wave toward you with basic attacks instead of pushing it with Q. If you spot the enemy jungler on the opposite side, push with Q and then recall or establish vision.
Vayne.combo: When Vayne is away from the minions, poke with Ezreal W Essence Flux → Ezreal Q Mystic Shot → basic attack. Detonating W with Q restores mana, and landing Q also reduces your other abilities’ cooldowns. If Vayne Q Tumble and Vayne E Condemn are down and you can close in, use W → basic attack → Q, then use Ezreal E Arcane Shift to change your angle and follow up with basic attacks.
Vayne.escape: Right after Vayne Q Tumble is a chance to close the distance, but don’t move near a wall while Vayne E Condemn is still available. Go in with Ezreal E Arcane Shift only after both abilities are down, and save E to escape if you’re in danger.
Vayne.phase: Ezreal comes online after completing two core items in the mid game, so look for objectives and towers then. In the late game, Vayne’s damage becomes hard to withstand with defensive stats alone, so play to avoid dragging the game out.
Vayne.teamfight: Deal damage from the edge of your range behind your frontline with Ezreal Q Mystic Shot and Ezreal W Essence Flux. Fight in open areas rather than narrow passages so you can avoid Vayne E Condemn. During Vayne R Final Hour, watch for the moment she comes out of stealth, and save Ezreal E Arcane Shift to escape if an enemy gets on you.

Varus.build: Start with Cloth Armor to withstand Varus’s main physical damage. Choose Plated Steelcaps for boots and build armor first. Since Varus W Blighted Quiver deals damage based on your max health, avoid relying on stacking health alone.
Varus.laning: When you don’t know where the enemy jungler is, reduce Q farming and pull the wave toward you with basic attacks. Decide when to recall before you run low on mana, and don’t rely on healing to hold your ground in Varus E Hail of Arrows.
Varus.combo: When Varus is away from the minions, poke with Ezreal W Essence Flux → Ezreal Q Mystic Shot → basic attack. Hit Ezreal Q Mystic Shot to reduce ability cooldowns, but don’t force a shot if there’s no angle to land it. When you have a safe chance to chase, use Ezreal W Essence Flux → basic attack → Ezreal Q Mystic Shot, then use Ezreal E Arcane Shift to change your angle and follow up with basic attacks.
Varus.escape: Varus has no ability to create distance on his own, so the window to close in comes after Varus R Chain of Corruption is down. Usually save Ezreal E Arcane Shift to escape; even if you use it aggressively during that window, change your angle to the side instead of blindly moving forward. If you fail to dodge Varus’s root, stop your engage and keep your distance.
Varus.teamfight: Deal damage from behind your frontline with Ezreal Q Mystic Shot and Ezreal W Essence Flux, and save Ezreal E Arcane Shift to escape if an enemy gets on you. If Varus R Chain of Corruption hits an ally, spread out so its tendrils don’t spread. Keep your distance while Varus is stronger after getting a kill or assist, then fight again once that period ends.
Varus.fight: When Varus aims Varus Q Piercing Arrow, sidestep its path and look for a chance to poke. Usually, apply Ezreal W Essence Flux and detonate it with Ezreal Q Mystic Shot to deal damage and restore mana. Use Ezreal E Arcane Shift to change your angle only when Varus R Chain of Corruption is down and you can safely close the gap.
Varus.phase: Ezreal comes online after completing two core items in the mid game, so minimize losses before then and keep building up damage. The provided information isn’t enough to say which side is stronger late game; keep fighting at the edge of your range.
Varus.watch: If Varus lands basic attacks with Varus W Blighted Quiver and builds up Blight, his next ability deals damage based on your maximum health. If you’ve been hit by several basic attacks, move out of Varus’s ability range to let the stacks expire. Sidestep when you see Varus aim Varus Q Piercing Arrow, and move away from allies caught by Varus R Chain of Corruption so the tendrils can’t reach you.

Zeri.watch: Zeri W Ultrashock Laser slows and spreads widely when it hits terrain, so don’t stand with a wall behind you or face her in a narrow passage. Zeri E Spark Surge travels farther when crossing a wall, so don’t push her toward one. Watch out for Zeri P Living Battery’s execute when your health is low, and don’t chase on foot while Zeri R Lightning Crash is active.
Zeri.build: Start with Cloth Armor to survive lane, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Zeri Q Burst Fire and Zeri W Ultrashock Laser deal her main physical damage, so build armor first. Zeri P Living Battery deals damage based on your max health, so don’t rely on stacking health alone.
Zeri.fight: Use Zeri’s short basic attack range to build up damage from a safe distance with Ezreal Q Mystic Shot. Right after you bait out Zeri E Spark Surge is a chance to close the distance, but use Ezreal E Arcane Shift aggressively only when you don’t need it to escape. Stop chasing while Zeri R Lightning Crash is active and her movement speed is increased.
Zeri.laning: Before Zeri gets her core items, use your range advantage to poke, but if you don’t know where the enemy jungler is, reduce Q farming and pull the wave toward you with basic attacks. Detonate Ezreal W Essence Flux with an ability to restore mana, and time your recall based on your mana.
Zeri.combo: When Zeri is away from the minions, poke with Ezreal W Essence Flux → Ezreal Q Mystic Shot → basic attack. Detonating W with Q restores mana, and landing Q also reduces the cooldowns of your abilities, including Ezreal E Arcane Shift. For an all-in after Zeri E Spark Surge is down, use W → basic attack → Q → E to change your angle and close in → basic attack, and use Ezreal R Trueshot Barrage if needed.
Zeri.escape: The opening to engage comes right after Zeri E Spark Surge is down; go in only after dodging the slow from Zeri W Ultrashock Laser as well. Usually save Ezreal E Arcane Shift to escape, and if you engage, use it at an angle that cuts off Zeri’s escape route. If Zeri E Spark Surge is still available, don’t use E forward and remove your own escape route.
Zeri.phase: Before Zeri gets her core items, look for chances to build a lead with your range advantage. Ezreal comes online after completing two core items in the mid game, and once Zeri has her core items, her mobility makes her hard to catch out.
Zeri.teamfight: Deal damage from behind your frontline with Ezreal Q Mystic Shot and Ezreal W Essence Flux. Avoid places where Zeri W Ultrashock Laser spreads after hitting terrain, and save Ezreal E Arcane Shift to escape if an enemy gets on you. Don’t chase on foot while Zeri R Lightning Crash is active, and target multiple enemies with Ezreal R Trueshot Barrage when they’re grouped up.

Ziggs.watch: If Ziggs’s E Hexplosive Minefield slows you, you’re more likely to get hit by his other abilities, so go around the mined path or wait for it to disappear. When you see the area of Ziggs R Mega Inferno Bomb, move away from the center of the blast even if you can’t get completely clear. Watch out for the displacement from Ziggs W Satchel Charge, and save Ezreal E Arcane Shift to escape.
Ziggs.build: Get movement speed first to deal with Ziggs’s damage, then build magic resistance. It’s important to walk out of telegraphed attack areas, and magic resistance helps you withstand any damage you fail to dodge.
Ziggs.laning: When you don’t know where the enemy jungler is, reduce Q farming and pull the lane toward you with basic attacks. After Ziggs uses Ziggs W Satchel Charge to clear the wave, look to trade from a direction without mines.
Ziggs.combo: When Ziggs is away from the minions, poke with Ezreal W Essence Flux → Ezreal Q Mystic Shot → basic attack. Detonating W with Q restores mana, and landing Q also reduces your other abilities’ cooldowns. If Ziggs W Satchel Charge is down and there’s a clear path without mines, use Ezreal E Arcane Shift to change your angle and follow up with attacks.
Ziggs.escape: The moment after Ziggs W Satchel Charge is down is a chance to close the distance with Ezreal E Arcane Shift. If Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield is still up, first check for a path that avoids its slow. When you’re not going in, save E to escape Ziggs’s displacement or other threats.
Ziggs.phase: Ezreal is weak early, and Ezreal E Arcane Shift comes online late, so prioritize CS and a safe distance over kills. After completing two core items in the mid game, make use of your sustained damage in fights. Even late game, attack from the edge of your range instead of stepping forward, and save E to escape.
Ziggs.teamfight: Deal damage from behind your frontline with Ezreal Q Mystic Shot and Ezreal W Essence Flux. Avoid Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield, and don’t group up in front of objectives where multiple allies can get hit by Ziggs R Mega Inferno Bomb. Once Ziggs W Satchel Charge is down, attack while your allies hold him in place, and use Ezreal E Arcane Shift to escape when a threat gets on you.
Ziggs.fight: The moment Ziggs W Satchel Charge goes down is your chance to close the distance. Before then, don’t use Ezreal E Arcane Shift aggressively; build damage from angles where you can land Ezreal Q Mystic Shot. Don’t move in toward the direction Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield is laid.

Nilah.watch: When Nilah Q Formless Blade hits, it briefly increases her attack range and hits in a cone, so take another step back. Watch for Nilah E Slipstream dashes, and save Ezreal E Arcane Shift as an escape. Nilah R Apotheosis pulls enemies in and also provides healing, so keep your distance from allies while Nilah has R available.
Nilah.build: Nilah’s primary damage is physical, so start with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps. If the healing from Nilah P Joy Unending, Q Formless Blade, and R Apotheosis becomes a problem in extended fights, buy Executioner’s Calling early. Ezreal Q Mystic Shot lets you keep your distance and apply Grievous Wounds. Also build health alongside armor, accounting for the penetration on Nilah Q Formless Blade.
Nilah.fight: Before Nilah closes in, build up damage with Ezreal Q Mystic Shot from outside her range. If Nilah W Jubilant Veil is active, stop basic attacking and respond with abilities or wait for the effect to end. Trade after Nilah E Slipstream and W Jubilant Veil are down, and use Ezreal E Arcane Shift carefully to dodge Nilah’s engage.
Nilah.laning: Farm with Q Mystic Shot from a safe distance. If you don’t know where the enemy jungler is, use basic attacks to pull the wave toward you so Q farming doesn’t push the lane. Right after Nilah Q Formless Blade hits, retreat beyond Nilah’s increased attack range.
Nilah.combo: If Nilah is away from the wave and hasn’t used W Jubilant Veil, poke with Ezreal W Essence Flux → Q Mystic Shot → basic attack. Detonating W with Q refunds mana, and hitting Q also reduces the cooldowns of your other abilities. If Nilah W Jubilant Veil is active, save your basic attacks until the effect ends.
Nilah.escape: If Nilah engages with E Slipstream, use Ezreal E Arcane Shift to create distance. Look for an opening to move forward only after Nilah has fully spent both E Slipstream and W Jubilant Veil and you have dodged the pull from Nilah R Apotheosis. Until then, don’t use Ezreal E Arcane Shift aggressively.
Nilah.phase: Ezreal hits his stride in the mid game, after completing two core items, so avoid major losses before then. There isn’t enough information to say who is stronger late game, so build up damage from maximum range and watch for Nilah’s engage.
Nilah.teamfight: Spread out from your allies so several of you aren’t caught in Nilah R Apotheosis together. From behind the frontline, Ezreal builds damage with Q Mystic Shot and W Essence Flux, and saves E Arcane Shift to prepare for Nilah E Slipstream’s engage. If Nilah engages and uses W Jubilant Veil, look for a chance to lock her down with your allies’ immobilizing crowd control.

Yasuo.build: Start with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for your boots. Yasuo’s primary damage is physical, and Ezreal has relatively low armor, so build armor first.
Yasuo.fight: Use cheap poke to break Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield first, then start trading after he fires his tornado and his knock-up is briefly unavailable. If Yasuo E Sweeping Blade and R Last Breath are still available, don’t use Ezreal E Arcane Shift to engage; save it to escape.
Yasuo.laning: Keep a thin wave on your side of the lane to reduce the number of minions Yasuo E Sweeping Blade can dash through. If you don’t know where the enemy jungler is, use basic attacks to pull the wave toward you instead of pushing with Q farming.
Yasuo.combo: Break Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield first. If Yasuo W Wind Wall is unavailable and Yasuo is away from the wave, poke with Ezreal W Essence Flux → Ezreal Q Mystic Shot → basic attack. Detonating W with Q refunds mana, and hitting Q also reduces the cooldowns of your other abilities.
Yasuo.escape: Right after dodging the tornado from Yasuo Q Steel Tempest, his knock-up is briefly unavailable, giving you a chance to trade. Before using Ezreal E Arcane Shift to close the distance, make sure Yasuo E Sweeping Blade and R Last Breath are also down. Until then, save Ezreal E Arcane Shift to escape Yasuo’s engage.
Yasuo.phase: Ezreal hits his stride in the mid game, after completing two core items, so minimize losses before then. The information provided isn’t enough to judge which of the two champions is stronger late game.
Yasuo.teamfight: Build up damage with Ezreal Q Mystic Shot and W Essence Flux from maximum range behind your frontline. If Yasuo W Wind Wall blocks projectiles, look for an angle to go around it or save key abilities until the wall disappears. Save Ezreal E Arcane Shift to escape after Yasuo closes in.
Yasuo.watch: After Yasuo lands Q Steel Tempest twice, his next tornado will knock you up, so watch for the sound and effect and dodge to the side. Yasuo E Sweeping Blade closes the distance by dashing through minions, and Yasuo W Wind Wall blocks projectiles such as Ezreal Q Mystic Shot, so save your key abilities until the wall disappears or you have an angle to go around it.
